thread:
Maya (Support): customer on enterprise plan says invoice INV-2026-0456 shows PA sales tax but their PO and billing address are NJ. they need a corrected invoice for AP. PO# PO-7890. customer is threatening to hold payment unless fixed. :grimacing:

Ethan (Billing): can you paste invoice id + payment id and screenshot from the customer? any card last4? also did they include a resale certificate?

Maya (Support): INV-2026-0456, payment id pay_3JxZ... last4 4242. attached screenshot (customer redacted). billing address on their PO: "Acme Resale Inc, 100 Bay St, Newark, NJ 07102". our invoice shows "PA 6%" tax line. customer says they filled NJ in the billing form.

Invoice Bot: TaxEngine v2.1 calculated tax using jurisdiction lookup order: billing_address -> po_billing_address -> payment_method_bin. Result: fallback_to_bin_state=PA (bank routing state).

Priya (Finance): quick note on policy: we default to billing address, then PO billing address. bin fallback only if address parsing fails. if PO included state we should honor it. looks like parsing returned null state so bin used. we need to correct this and issue a credit/refund.

Jorge (Engineering): dug into logs for INV-2026-0456. repro snippet: 
```
[TaxEngine] parse_address("Acme Resale Inc
100 Bay St
Newark, NJ 07102") -> state: null (regex failed due to newline + trailing comma)
[TaxEngine] fallback -> payment_method.bin_state = PA
[TaxEngine] applied_tax_rate = 6.00%
```
This is a bug in the address normalization regex; it fails when the address has a trailing comma after city.

Ethan (Billing): ok — customer preference? refund to card or credit note to apply to next invoice? they want AP-friendly docs, so prefer corrected invoice and credit note so their team can close PO.

Priya (Finance): agree. plan: 1) create credit note for tax amount $297.50 (reversal of PA tax) 2) reissue corrected invoice with NJ tax 6.625% or tax-exempt depending on resale cert. 3) if customer provides resale cert we void tax on new invoice. customer said they have resale cert, will send within 24h.

Jorge (Engineering): prioritizing a small hotfix: change address parser to strip commas and accept newline-separated states. I'll open PR and ship to prod lane. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/taxengine/pulls/487 (hotfix). ETA for deploy ~2 hours once CI passes. also adding additional telemetry to surface when fallback to BIN happens.

Maya (Support): telling customer: we will issue a credit note immediately and reissue invoice once we confirm their resale cert. customer ok with credit note to speed AP.

Ethan (Billing): taking action now: creating credit note CN-2026-0102 for $297.50 and linking to INV-2026-0456. will mark as 'awaiting customer resale cert' on new invoice.

Invoice Bot: Credit note CN-2026-0102 created and linked to INV-2026-0456. Audit id: audit_tx_90021.

Priya (Finance): once resale cert arrives, we'll zero-rate new invoice or apply NJ rate. update tickets and book adjustment in the current month. will coordinate refund to card if customer prefers.

Jorge (Engineering): hotfix merged, rolling out to prod now. will monitor tax-rate mismatches metric.

Maya (Support): customer updated: they prefer credit note applied to the corrected invoice. they emailed resale cert (attached). requesting confirmation email once new invoice issued.

Ethan (Billing): reissued invoice INV-2026-0456-v2 with NJ jurisdiction (resale cert applied) and applied CN-2026-0102. emailed AP contact with corrected PDF and accounting fields. closing loop.

Maya (Support): thanks team — customer confirmed AP accepted documents and will process payment. moving to resolved. proposed follow-ups: (1) postmortem on address parsing issue, (2) add unit test for comma/newline cases, (3) update customer-facing docs about what fields determine tax jurisdiction.

Priya (Finance): noted. i'll open a finance ops ticket to review any other invoices that fell back to BIN in last 30 days.

Jorge (Engineering): created follow-up tasks and assigned to tax-engine squad. ticket: ENG-1245.

Maya (Support): closing thread, tagging for FYI: @channel :white_check_mark:
